teams.detail: Swept D-Backs — Robles walk-off RBI infield single in 10th (May 31). Tonight vs. Mets at 9:40 PM PT — after brief cutoff.
Season ended in East Semis (lost to Cavs). No. 21 pick via MIN swap. Priority: re-sign Tobias Harris, add offensive help for Cade.
OTAs through June 4. Super Bowl LX champs. Franchise sale imminent — new owner possibly in place by August at $10B+.
Season opener vs. WSU Sept. 6 on NBC (1 PM PT). Official visits May 31. Big Ten home tickets on sale June 15.
Added Beasley (USF, 13.6 ppg) and Venters (Gonzaga). Diallo transferred to Kentucky. Sprinkle rebuilding for '26-27.

headlines.headline: SPURS DOWN THUNDER IN GAME 7; WEMBY HEADS TO NBA FINALS VS. KNICKS
headlines.detail: Wembanyama 22 pts, 7 reb. SGA had 35 for OKC. Finals tip June 3 on ABC at AT&T Center.

headlines.headline: EAGLES TRADE A.J. BROWN TO PATRIOTS FOR 2028 FIRST-ROUND PICK
headlines.detail: Deal timed after June 1 to split $43.5M dead cap over two seasons. Brown becomes Patriots' WR1.

headlines.headline: UW OPENS 2026 SEASON VS. WASHINGTON STATE ON NBC; BIG TEN TICKETS JUNE 15
headlines.detail: Apple Cup opener Sept. 6 (NBC, 1 PM PT). Utah State Sept. 12, EWU Sept. 19 (both BTN).

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL WINDS DOWN AS BLUE BLOODS RELOAD; NCAA CONFIRMS 76-TEAM FIELD
headlines.detail: Kentucky added Zoom Diallo; UW added Beasley and Venters. Tournament expanding to 76 teams.
